archive_format: Deterministic gzip (mtime 0 and empty filename) containing sorted regular POSIX-relative tar members with fixed ownership, mode and timestamps.

benchmark_inputs.note: Restore the public input files at the source-relative historical location when inspecting the archived public evaluator.

external_assets.checkpoint_identities: models/manifest.json records original and exported checkpoint hashes; experiments/configs/ contains the retained scientific metadata.
external_assets.historical_defaults: Original output paths and tracker project names remain byte-identical inside the provenance archive. Review configuration before any separately authorized historical execution.

limitations: Source hashes establish consistency with the local recorded commits and matching ablation receipts, not independent external authenticity.
No historical training, inference or solver execution was performed while creating this archive.
The historical dependency specifications are included where they existed; absent specifications and unpinned versions remain unresolved historical limits.
Checkpoint-to-source assignments follow the recorded training_source_commit fields in models/manifest.json.
purpose: Immutable source provenance for the paper training and inference versions. Original scientific code and source-relative paths are retained; extraction does not modify the active release.
